dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: I'm a mercenary from Aaru Village. If you're asking about the local nonsense, go annoy someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: It's a heck of a place, but at least life is better here than in Aaru Village.

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Otherwise who would have come all the way here to work for the darn Akademiya? I'm not stupid!
